listing.description: Perps web3 is a multi-component trading and research project built as a suite rather than a single monolithic application. Its buyer-facing surfaces cover market and oracle visibility, Quorm rail operations, strategy research, SYNTH trading and delegated trading-profile workflows, while Sorites and Quorm service components remain available as explicit diagnostic surfaces where a faithful browser product is not currently possible. cApp publishes each verified component independently but keeps them together under one canonical project, so visitors can move between real product surfaces without losing the context of the wider system. Product and diagnostic classifications are kept explicit throughout: a generated compatibility surface is never presented as though it were the original application.
features: One canonical project with independently verified component demos
Five browser-ready product surfaces across trading
Explicit diagnostic surfaces for service-heavy or non-browser components
listing.summary: One canonical project bringing together independently runnable trading products, oracle and rail tooling, research labs, Sorites services and honest diagnostic surfaces.
listing.tagline: A modular trading, oracle and strategy research suite
listing.title: Perps web3

listing.description: Quorm is the large core workspace that ties together market-facing services, verification and supporting infrastructure used across the Perps web3 project. Its current cApp Showcase surface is intentionally diagnostic: cApp can preserve and inspect the source and service topology, but the repository does not expose a single browser-ready product entry that faithfully represents the whole system. The diagnostic surface is therefore presented as an honest view into the component rather than being labelled as the original Quorm application.
